messages:
Priya (Docs): Hey team — PR 6221 is ready for final pass. It's the private-deploy KMS migration guide. Please review for redaction needs and CI. Link: https://git/repo/pr/6221
Sam (Platform): Thanks. Quick heads up: docs preview failed on linkcheck and a broken relative path. I'll fix the link in a branch in a minute.
Marta (CI-bot): CI status: docs-preview failed on step "linkcheck" — 1 broken link. Full log: https://ci/reports/6221
Priya (Docs): @Sam (Platform) appreciate it. Also flagged by Legal for sensitive KMS snippet — @Luis (Legal) can you confirm if the snippet needs redaction or a gated snippet (placeholder + request form)?
Luis (Legal): Looping in. From a quick look, the raw KMS example includes customer key ARN pattern — we should redact ARNs and replace with <KMS_KEY_ARN>. Also suggest adding a short note about not pasting production keys.
Jordan (Security): Agreed with redaction. Also suggest removing the HSM-specific command that exposes device IDs. Replace with a generic command and point to the internal appendix for advanced ops.
Priya (Docs): OK I'll prepare a redaction patch. Question on approvals: do we need an explicit security + legal approval before merge, or can we merge after redaction and then loop for sign-off? We have a customer demo scheduled tomorrow.
Luis (Legal): For docs that reference customer secrets/ARNS, we require sign-off before publishing. Quick path: push redacted changes to the PR and add a brief approval comment thread. We'll approve same day if redaction is applied.
Sam (Platform): If approval is blocking the demo, we can do a canary publish to internal site only. @Marta (CI-bot) can we run a docs-preview that deploys to internal preview rather than public? 
Marta (CI-bot): New job 'preview-internal' created. Run command: `ci run preview-internal --pr 6221`. It will deploy to internal.rw-docs-preview.local. ETA ~5 minutes.
Priya (Docs): I'll submit the redaction patch now, mention @Luis and @Jordan, and run preview-internal. Thanks everyone.
Luis (Legal): Thanks. Once redaction patch is up, I'll review immediately.
Sam (Platform): FYI I'm also fixing the relative link. Will push in same PR.
Priya (Docs): Patch pushed: https://git/repo/pr/6221/files — redacted ARNs, removed HSM device IDs, linkfix done. Running preview-internal.
Marta (CI-bot): preview-internal started for PR 6221 — job 98765. Link: https://internal.rw-docs-preview.local/pr/6221
Luis (Legal): Reviewing now.
Jordan (Security): Quick security pass done. Approved pending Legal sign-off. :thumbsup:
Luis (Legal): Approved. Please squash-merge after CI green and add a changelog entry 'redacted KMS ARNs — security/legal compliance'.
Priya (Docs): Will do. Target merge window: in 30 mins after preview finishes. Thanks all. :tada:
